'''2005 U.S. National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship in Columbus, Ohio (July 2005 (Origins)). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Columbus, Ohio
* '''Dates:''' July 2005 (Origins)
